dimensions.assessment: Directly affects veterans receiving compensation for a service-connected disability relating to a mental health diagnosis.
dimensions.evidence: veteran who is receiving compensation under this chapter for a service-connected disability relating to a mental health diagnosis

dimensions.assessment: Veterans are offered annual mental health consultations and targeted outreach through phone calls, texts, emails, or letters.
dimensions.evidence: offer a mental health consultation to assess the mental health needs of, and discuss other mental health care options for, the veteran

dimensions.assessment: Extends higher home loan fee rates through May 12, 2035, affecting federal loan program revenues.
dimensions.evidence: The loan fee table in section 3729(b)(2) of title 38... striking 'June 9, 2034' each place it appears and inserting 'May 12, 2035'

dimensions.assessment: Amends title 38, United States Code, to mandate new VA outreach procedures, reporting requirements, and a GAO review.
dimensions.evidence: direct the Secretary of Veterans Affairs to furnish annual mental health consultations to certain veterans

dimensions.assessment: Establishes ongoing annual consultation requirements for the VA and extends loan fee provisions through 2035.
dimensions.evidence: Not less frequently than once each year, the Secretary shall... offer a mental health consultation

missing_information: Specific cost projections for conducting the mandated annual mental health outreach and consultations are not provided.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires the VA to furnish annual mental health consultations and conduct structured outreach to certain disabled veterans, and extends certain home loan fee rates through May 12, 2035.
